mapper.select: SELECT outbox_id, event_id, notification_id, campaign_id, dedupe_key, status, publish_attempts, available_at, claimed_at, published_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_outbox WHERE outbox_id = #{outboxId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', publish_attempts = publish_attempts + 1, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE outbox_id = #{outboxId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE outbox_id = #{outboxId}
UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', available_at = #{availableAt}, last_error = 'stale publisher claim recovered' WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_at < #{staleBefore}
